title: Indicating and Recording — Flight Data Recorder — Fifty Hour Unit and Extended Parameter Frame

issue.reason: Initial issue of the fifty hour recorder and extended parameter frame bulletin.

abstract: Mandatory replacement of the flight data recorder by the fifty hour unit and re-strapping of the data concentrator for the additional acquisition channels, required by the operational rule applicable from 2024.

sections.planning_reason: The revised operational rule applicable from 2024 requires fifty hours of recorded flight data and adds thirty-one parameters to the mandatory list, of which nineteen were not previously recorded on the type. Two accident investigation authorities separately recommended the additional flight control and engine parameters. No exemption is available to operators, so every delivered aircraft has to be brought to the new standard before the rule date. The associated airworthiness directive makes this bulletin mandatory.
sections.description: The recorder unit is replaced by an item with four times the non-volatile memory, the recorder control panel gains a revised legend, the mounting tray depth is set with new spacers and the data concentrator is re-strapped for the additional acquisition channels.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-energise the aircraft and apply the electrical safety precautions. Open the aft equipment area access in zone 146 and the avionics compartment access in zone 171. Remove the recorder computer D3130118235301 from its mounting tray. Install spacers AGS103845-6C to set the new tray depth and install the fifty hour unit. Fit the revised legend to the recorder control panel D3130006987696. Re-strap the data concentrator 6828FW for the additional acquisition channels to the table in the accomplishment instructions. Do the recorder built-in test and confirm the mounting tray 5347FP and the recorder computer 582FW are correctly identified. Do a full download and confirm that all mandatory parameters are present and correctly scaled. Install the access panels, update the aircraft technical record with the new unit serial number, and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all aircraft MSN C00001 through C00607 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00612 onward carry the fifty hour unit from build. A mixed standard between the recorder and the data concentrator is not a dispatchable configuration and the aircraft must not be released until both are at the same standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K3130-1014-01 contains the recorder unit, the spacers, the control panel legend and the strapping label. Lead time is thirty-four weeks and allocation during the campaign was managed centrally against the rule date. Removed units are returned to the vendor for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: Before 1 January 2025, or within 18 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

title: Indicating and Recording — Flight Data Recorder — Fifty Hour Unit and Extended Parameter Frame

issue.reason: Compliance statement clarified to say that the mandatory retention stands whatever else on the aircraft offloads the same parameters.

Operators have asked whether a system that reads the same parameters off the aircraft by another route can stand in for part of this embodiment. It cannot. The retention required here is a property of the recorder itself, mandated by the operational rule and by the associated airworthiness directive, and it is unaffected by any other equipment that acquires, stores or offloads the same data for its own purpose. No such installation reduces the scope of this bulletin, changes its compliance date or makes any part of it optional.

type_data.compliance_time: Before 1 January 2025, or within 18 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first. Compliance is required in full irrespective of any other on-board system that records or offloads the same parameters.

revision_history.reason: Compliance statement clarified: the mandatory recorder retention is unaffected by any other system offloading the same parameters
